headline: Online English Tutor

skill_groups.label: Teaching
items: teaching English to speakers of other languages

summary: Former customer service representative now tutoring English online full time. After three years on a telecom voice account, I completed TESOL training and have spent the past year teaching Japanese and Korean learners. My call centre years taught me patience and how to explain things clearly to anyone.

experience.title: Online English Tutor
bullets: Teach 25-minute one-on-one lessons to about 30 Japanese and Korean learners a week.
Plan lessons around each learner's goals, from business meetings to travel.
Give level tests and written feedback so learners can see their progress.

experience.title: Customer Service Representative
bullets: Answered billing and technical calls for a US telecom client.
Explained plans and fixes step by step to callers of all ages.
Kept satisfaction scores above target in 30 of 36 months.
